headline: SEA @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.58 at KCR 3.70, with a projected total of 8.28. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: SEA moved +0.06 runs while KCR moved -0.76, changing the projected margin by +0.82 runs. The projected total fell -0.70, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: George Kirby has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bobby Witt Jr., Randy Arozarena, Maikel Garcia, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rob Refsnyder, Connor Joe because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
